name: VRS-1 Variance-Ratio Regime Switch
description: Lo-MacKinlay variance ratio VR = Var(q-bar move) / (q * Var(1-bar move)) classifies the regime each bar. VR >= 1.15 (trending) takes 20-bar Donchian breakouts; VR <= 0.85 (mean-reverting) fades Bollinger band crossbacks; between the two it stands aside. Stop and target are both fixed at entry from ATR(14) -- trend 1.2/2.4x, reversion 1.0/1.2x -- plus a 48-bar max-hold flatten. No trailing stop.
pineSource:
//@version=6
// VRS-1 "Variance-Ratio Regime Switch" — crypto port (24/7, no session filter)
// KEPT: Lo-MacKinlay variance-ratio regime classification; Donchian breakout in TREND;
//       Bollinger band-fade in REVERT; fixed ATR stop + target set at entry; max-hold flatten.
// REFUSED/DROPPED: nothing forbidden was requested. No trailing stop (fixed SL/TP by design),
//       no pyramiding, no cross-symbol data, no martingale or averaging down.
strategy("VRS-1 Variance-Ratio Regime Switch", overlay=true,
     pyramiding=1, process_orders_on_close=true,
     commission_type=strategy.commission.percent, commission_value=0.05,
     initial_capital=10000,
     default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=100,
     margin_long=100, margin_short=100)

// ---- inputs ----
q       = input.int(5,     "VR horizon q")
L       = input.int(120,   "VR lookback")
vrHi    = input.float(1.15, "Trend threshold")
vrLo    = input.float(0.85, "Revert threshold")
dcLen   = input.int(20,    "Donchian length")
bbLen   = input.int(20,    "BB length")
bbMult  = input.float(2.0, "BB mult")
atrLen  = input.int(14,    "ATR length")
tSL     = input.float(1.2, "Trend SL xATR")
tTP     = input.float(2.4, "Trend TP xATR")
rSL     = input.float(1.0, "Revert SL xATR")
rTP     = input.float(1.2, "Revert TP xATR")
maxBars = input.int(48,    "Max bars in trade")

// ---- variance ratio: VR = Var(q-bar move) / (q * Var(1-bar move)) ----
r1 = close - close[1]
rq = close - close[q]
v1 = ta.variance(r1, L)
vq = ta.variance(rq, L)
vr = v1 > 0 ? vq / (q * v1) : na

// ---- signal series ----
atr = ta.atr(atrLen)
[bbMid, bbUp, bbLo] = ta.bb(close, bbLen, bbMult)
hh = ta.highest(high, dcLen)[1]
ll = ta.lowest(low, dcLen)[1]

trendRegime  = not na(vr) and vr >= vrHi
revertRegime = not na(vr) and vr <= vrLo

longTrend  = trendRegime  and ta.crossover(close, hh)
shortTrend = trendRegime  and ta.crossunder(close, ll)
longRev    = revertRegime and ta.crossover(close, bbLo)
shortRev   = revertRegime and ta.crossunder(close, bbUp)

// ---- state ----
var float slPx   = na
var float tpPx   = na
var int   barsIn = 0

flat = strategy.position_size == 0

// ---- entries: stop and target are both computed at the moment of entry ----
if flat and longTrend
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
    slPx   := close - atr * tSL
    tpPx   := close + atr * tTP
    barsIn := 0
else if flat and shortTrend
    strategy.entry("S", strategy.short)
    slPx   := close + atr * tSL
    tpPx   := close - atr * tTP
    barsIn := 0
else if flat and longRev
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
    slPx   := close - atr * rSL
    tpPx   := close + atr * rTP
    barsIn := 0
else if flat and shortRev
    strategy.entry("S", strategy.short)
    slPx   := close + atr * rSL
    tpPx   := close - atr * rTP
    barsIn := 0

// ---- exits: fixed bracket re-issued each bar at the SAME prices set on entry ----
if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("LX", from_entry="L", stop=slPx, limit=tpPx)
    barsIn := barsIn + 1
if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("SX", from_entry="S", stop=slPx, limit=tpPx)
    barsIn := barsIn + 1

// ---- max-hold flatten (time stop, not a trailing stop) ----
if barsIn >= maxBars and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all()
    barsIn := 0

plot(vr, title="VarianceRatio")
plot(trendRegime ? 1 : revertRegime ? -1 : 0, title="Regime")
notes: REJECTED. The regime switch has no edge at this trade frequency: average trade is roughly -0.02%, and commission at 0.05% consumes 36-53% of gross profit across both symbols. Note the engine's forced parity profile sizes every trade at 100% of equity, which is NOT the spec's 0.5%-risk sizing -- so this tests the signal, not the spec's risk management. The signal is what failed. The ETH run also raised an 'oversized_position_sizing' warning from the engine. Commission paid $7,937 against $14,895 gross profit.
